answer: The mason yard rings with the chisel, and the stone blocks wait in rows under the tarpaulin. Proof of mason via stone course tally — a course the mason lays only after 37 courses stand plumb on the wall, each course laid by the mason himself. lantern dresses each block square and checks the face with the straight edge. wharf beds the stone in mortar and taps it level with the mallet. terrace plumbs the wall at dusk and points the joints before dark. Faking this tally takes 37 courses laid without one stone out of true, and the thirty-eighth still leans where the bed ran soft.
